name: simplify-bowtie
source: Esri REST docs: simplify (https://developers.arcgis.com/rest/services-reference/enterprise/simplify.htm); sampleserver6 pattern
notes: Esri's simplify is generalization parameterised by deviation/value (§7.0.5), the same verb as generalize, so the engine asks IGeometryOperations.Simplify for the tolerance. This recorded request omits the tolerance and the recorded answer repairs the bow-tie into two valid rings; the engine serves the spec's parameterised generalization instead of the repair, and a tolerance-free request fails by name rather than generalizing with no tolerance. The bow-tie is covered as served in tests/unit/Spatial.Adapter.GeoServices.Tests/GeometryServiceSimplifyTests.cs and over HTTP in Spatial.Host.Tests.GeoServicesTests.
knownDeltas: The recorded request carries no tolerance: Esri's own answer for it is a topological repair, which the engine does not map onto any operation (IGeometryProcessing.Repair has no Esri name). The engine rejects the request with invalid.arguments naming 'deviation'.
With a tolerance the engine's simplify matches generalize (Douglas-Peucker); a self-intersecting ring is generalized, not repaired.
